hero.title: Technical support from equipment selection through operation
hero.lead: Minline Systems offers an end-to-end approach — from analysing a project's technical requirements through equipment selection, installation, commissioning, service, repair and modernization. The goal is to keep equipment running reliably and to reduce operational risk.

cards.title: Technical Audit and Equipment Selection
cards.text: Selecting the right technical solution and equipment configuration based on an analysis of well and operating conditions.

cards.title: Installation and Commissioning
cards.text: Installation, adjustment, bringing equipment to its working regime and, where required, training the operating personnel.

cards.title: Service and Maintenance
cards.text: Planned maintenance, prompt response to failures and support in optimising the operating regime.

cards.title: Repair and Modernization
cards.text: Restoring equipment performance, renewing assemblies and improving efficiency.

blocks.title: Technical Audit and Equipment Selection
blocks.body: A technical audit examines operating conditions, well characteristics, existing infrastructure and project objectives. Suitable equipment and configuration are then selected on that basis. The aim is an optimal balance between technical requirements, project budget and operating efficiency.

blocks.title: Installation and Commissioning
blocks.body: This stage covers installation at the site, adjustment work and bringing the equipment to the working regime defined in the technical specification. Where required, operating training can also be provided to the client's personnel.

blocks.title: Service and Maintenance
blocks.body: Service covers planned preventive maintenance, assessment of technical condition, identification of worn assemblies and measures to preserve operating stability. The main goal is to reduce downtime risk and extend equipment service life.

blocks.title: Repair and Modernization
blocks.body: Repair and modernization help improve the efficiency of existing equipment, renew individual assemblies and extend the service life of the system. This approach improves the technical outcome without a full replacement.

steps.title: Consultation and technical specification
steps.text: Initial analysis of requirements, operating conditions and project objectives.

steps.title: Preparing the technical proposal
steps.text: Shaping a technical solution and configuration around the client's needs.

steps.title: Agreement and planning
steps.text: Agreeing supply terms, schedule, pricing and the work plan.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: Supply, installation, adjustment, testing and readiness for operation.

steps.title: Control and handover
steps.text: Final inspection, documentation, warranty and subsequent technical support.
